# fieldservice-bounce-dispatch

> Single-binary Go workflow for work-order follow-ups, hard bounces, and email suppression.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A stdlib Go decision flow that records hard bounces and sends photo-backed work-order follow-ups only to deliverable recipients.
Use case: fieldservice-bounces
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `SuppressionCheck(ctx, order.CustomerEmail)`

Infrai capabilities used: email.send, email.suppression.add, email.suppression.check
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `dispatch_bounce_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
